Insight: The data reveals that CLINIQUE leads in total review volume with over 49,000 reviews, suggesting the strongest customer engagement footprint, while fresh commands the highest average rating (4.38) and recommendation rate (87%), indicating superior customer satisfaction despite a smaller review base. A notable anomaly worth flagging is Drunk Elephant's performance: despite ranking third in review volume , a sign of strong brand awareness and trial , it posts the lowest average rating (4.09) and recommendation rate (77%) among all five brands, suggesting a meaningful gap between customer expectations and product experience. Sephora should conduct a deeper diagnostic into Drunk Elephant's lowest-rated SKUs and review sentiment to identify specific pain points, as improving satisfaction for an already high-traffic brand represents one of the highest-leverage opportunities to convert engagement into loyalty and repeat purchase.

The data reveals a dramatic growth in review volume from roughly 2,800 reviews in 2008 to a peak of over 215,000 in 2020, likely amplified by the pandemic-driven shift to online shopping, while average ratings have gradually softened from a high of 4.46 in 2009–2010 to a low of 4.21 in 2020. A notable anomaly worth flagging is the sharp decline in reviews during 2023 (approximately 50,000), which likely reflects partial-year data but could also signal declining engagement or changes to the review submission process that warrant investigation. Sephora should closely examine the inverse relationship between review volume and average rating , as the platform scaled and attracted a broader, less brand-loyal reviewer base, satisfaction scores dipped , and consider implementing post-purchase review prompts targeted at verified, satisfied customers to stabilize ratings while sustaining the high engagement volumes achieved in recent years.

The data reveals that products targeting oily skin lead in both average rating (4.29) and recommendation rate (84%), despite having the smallest review volume, while combination skin dominates total engagement with over 544K reviews , more than the other three segments combined. The most notable anomaly is the normal skin segment, which significantly underperforms with the lowest rating (4.20) and a recommendation rate of just 75%, lagging nearly 10 percentage points behind oily skin , suggesting that products marketed to "normal" skin may lack a compelling value proposition or suffer from vague positioning that fails to address specific concerns. Sephora should conduct a deeper assortment and formulation review of its normal-skin portfolio, potentially rebranding or refining product claims to target more specific needs, while simultaneously leveraging the high satisfaction in the oily-skin category to expand that assortment and amplify it through targeted marketing and user-generated content campaigns.
